Every core caller guards on it: substrate-agent.ts:1944 (donor :1981) runs the turn without runWithChargeContext, moa-turn.ts:213 likewise, moa-turn.ts:432-433 prices a round at 0 with multiplier 1, inspectChargeSurface/chargeSurface return null without a policy (run-charge.ts:376-378, :520-523), getRunChargeSnapshot returns undefined outside a charge context (:443-447), and buildChargePromptVariables reports runtime_charge_budget_present false with empty values (runtime-context-sections/charge.ts:61-69). The 25 core importers of the contract and the 10 of run-charge stay unchanged
column5: Lite: no run-charge quotas, no Charge quota exceeded errors, no agent.charge events, the charge prompt variables always report no budget. Donor with charge-policy.seed.json: per-lane quotas (interactive 24, companion_social 24, background 16, maintenance 0, subagent 6, shard 12) and surface costs gated MOA rounds, subagent launches and other surfaces. A host that sets config.chargePolicy itself still gets the donor behaviour

column4: Capability tiers (stub): the CapabilityRuntime import, field, setCapabilityRuntime, and its branches in refreshCapabilityRuntime, resolveCapabilityAccess and snapshotCapabilityGrant are removed. The tier now comes only from an injected CapabilityAccess (setCapabilityAccess, kept) or from SubstrateConfig.capabilityTier through normalizeCapabilityTier, whose fallback is nursery (system/capabilities/tiers.ts:88-93), the same tier as the donor seed (config/capability-tier.seed.json: {"tier": "nursery", "customTokens": []}). tier-types.ts and tiers.ts stay core. system/capabilities/runtime.ts and system/config/capability-tier-config.ts are now kind cut
column5: Lite: the tier is fixed by the host (config.capabilityTier or an injected access, default nursery); capability-tier.json is never read and owner edits to it are not picked up per turn. Donor: CapabilityRuntime re-read capability-tier.json on each refresh and supported the custom tier with customTokens from that file
